title: System Usability Scale (SUS)
description: Standard 10-item System Usability Scale (Brooke, 1996), adapted to name the EFL IndexDB prototype. Scoring: odd items = response − 1; even items = 5 − response; SUS = sum × 2.5 (range 0–100).

questions.text: I think that I would like to use the EFL IndexDB prototype frequently.
I found the EFL IndexDB prototype unnecessarily complex.
I thought the EFL IndexDB prototype was easy to use.
I think that I would need the support of a technical person to be able to use the EFL IndexDB prototype.
I found the various functions in the EFL IndexDB prototype were well integrated.
I thought there was too much inconsistency in the EFL IndexDB prototype.
I would imagine that most people would learn to use the EFL IndexDB prototype very quickly.
I found the EFL IndexDB prototype very cumbersome to use.
I felt very confident using the EFL IndexDB prototype.
I needed to learn a lot of things before I could get going with the EFL IndexDB prototype.
